title: Call Me When You're Sober
lyrics:
[00:00.60]Don't cry to me
[00:02.87]If you loved me
[00:05.63]You would be here with me
[00:10.77]You want me?
[00:13.27]Come find me
[00:15.87]Make up your mind
[00:35.30]Should I let you fall? Lose it all?
[00:40.98]So maybe you can remember yourself
[00:46.22]Can't keep believing, we're only deceiving
[00:50.97]Ourselves and I'm sick of the lie
[00:57.84]And you're too late
[01:02.16]Don't cry to me
[01:04.50]If you loved me
[01:07.22]You would be here with me
[01:12.42]You want me?
[01:14.88]Come find me
[01:17.54]Make up your mind
[01:29.30]Couldn't take the blame, sick with shame
[01:35.06]Must be exhausting to lose your own game
[01:40.08]Selfishly hated, no wonder you're jaded
[01:44.91]You can't play the victim this time
[01:51.66]And you're too late
[01:55.87]So don't cry to me
[01:58.32]If you loved me
[02:01.09]You would be here with me
[02:06.19]You want me?
[02:08.81]Come find me
[02:11.48]Make up your mind
[02:21.76]You never call me when you're sober
[02:32.09]You only want it 'cause it's over
[02:40.79]It's over
[02:46.78]How could I have burned paradise?
[02:57.13]How could I? You were never mine!
[03:07.66]So don't cry to me
[03:10.27]If you loved me
[03:13.11]You would be here with me
[03:18.20]Don't lie to me
[03:20.52]Just get your things
[03:23.16]I've made up your mind
